newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Tail broke off in mid-air in Russian plane crash.
newsitem.headline: Tail broke off in mid-air in Russian plane crash.

text.p: The tail of an ageing Russian propeller plane broke off in midair before Tuesday's crash that killed 50 passengers and crew en route to Turkey, an official said on Wednesday.

Islam Burlakov, transportation prosecutor in the North Caucasus region where the accident took place, said the tail fell off the plane's body and landed in a different area from the rest of the wreckage.

But he told Reuters by telephone it was too soon to say what had caused the tail of the Stavropol Airlines' AN-24 charter flight to separate. Experts began their analysis of flight data recorded on the plane's two black boxes on Wednesday, he said.
The accident was the worst domestic disaster for Russia's troubled airline industry in more than a year.
By Wednesday rescuers had found 42 complete bodies and severed remains of the other eight victims, said Ivan Narochny, a local Emergencies Ministry official.

The accident occurred 37 minutes after the plane took off from Stavropol in south Russia and reached its cruising altitude en route to Trabzon on Turkey's northern coast, said Pyotr Markin, an assistant to the airline's director.
Officials said most if not all passengers were Russian "shuttle traders" who buy goods abroad to resell at home.
It was the worst air disaster in Russia since December 1995, when 97 died in a crash in the Russian Far East.
